title: Project Sync and Backbone command and local-action contracts
description: Closed DRY Project Move and PM content-update request/result/error/availability/disabled/permission/local-action families. Static owner contract only.

cmd.project.move.cancel.intended_semantics: Cancel the exact current Project Move operation only when the semantic owner reports it cancellable.

cmd.project.move.pause.intended_semantics: Request a durable safe-point pause for the exact Project Move; never freeze or serialize a live process as proof.

cmd.project.move.preflight.intended_semantics: Build an immutable Project/Vault move plan with exact topology, inventory, capacity, conflict, permission, FileSafe, recovery, and credential-readiness evidence.

cmd.project.move.resume.intended_semantics: Resume the same fenced Project Move operation from its durable continuation and current owner state.

cmd.project.move.retry.intended_semantics: Retry the same idempotent Project Move operation after revalidating currentness and the typed failure condition.

cmd.project.move.rollback.intended_semantics: Restore the last verified Project/Vault placement from the exact move recovery boundary or report recovery_required truthfully.

cmd.project.move.start.intended_semantics: Start the approved staged Project/Vault move while retaining the verified source and one-writer authority until cutover.

cmd.update.content.activate.intended_semantics: Atomically activate a verified staged PM content/catalog generation while retaining last-known-good rollback state.

cmd.update.content.check.intended_semantics: Run a coalesced, cached, policy-bounded check for the exact PM content update channel or catalog.

cmd.update.content.download.intended_semantics: Download and verify the selected PM content update artifact without activating it early.

cmd.update.content.rollback.intended_semantics: Roll back the exact PM content update operation to a verified retained generation or report recovery_required.
